description: 한국철도공사_정차역별 역무열차종별 승하차인원수 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 예를 들어, 특정 정차역에서 어떤 열차종이 이용이 많은지, 출퇴근 시간대나 연도별 이용 변화, 주요 환승역의 수요 집중, 지역별 승하차 비중 변화, 상·하행 불균형 등 교통량의 효율성과. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 정차역별 승하차 인원수, 역무열차종별 이용, 상하행 구분, 여객 이동 규모, 노선별 인구 유동. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
